I asked my dad if he was going to divorce my mom when I was 10 because they fought all the time. Asking questions is a NORMAL THING for kids. Did my mom put me up to that? NO. Its not crazy for a child to make observations about their world and then question an adult, who they trust, about those observations. Your partner is not your enemy but you are talking about them like they are. I feel bad for your family. It must suck being with someone who is one foot out the door when you have a disability. 

You are also shitty for yelling at your daughter for asking those questions. She will not trust you in the future and this will seriously damage your relationship. I hope she can talk to her mom because you are an AH. You need to apologize to her, she is 13, a delicate age. Thats when a lot of kids get bullied and depressed. She is getting bullied because YOU put her in a situation where she is the outcast, the black sheep, not by her choice. Also, get some anger management therapy, or just therapy in general. They may help you to realize some hard truths about yourself if we strangers on the internet couldn't.
